question: In which of the following forms of government does the executive enjoy the right to dissolve the Legislature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parliamentary form of government**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In a **Parliamentary form of government**, the executive (usually the Prime Minister) enjoys the right to dissolve the Legislature (Parliament).
 
• The **Prime Minister** can advise the head of state (such as the President or Monarch) to dissolve the Parliament, leading to general elections.
